capabilities: hide configured files and folders in the vault
protect hidden-item configuration with a password
toggle visibility via ribbon menu and command palette commands
keep exception files visible inside hidden folders
disambiguation: It does not encrypt files; it only visually hides them inside Obsidian.
extras: README warns the plugin provides no encryption and recommends combining it with Obsidian's built-in Excluded Files feature to keep hidden items out of search and graph view.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to visually conceal sensitive notes from the file explorer and workspace.
summary: Privacy plugin that hides configured files and folders in the vault behind a password-protected, toggleable visibility setting.
